thesis: The speakers discuss the origins of Jason Calacanis's career, starting from his family's financial difficulties in the 1980s to his work fixing laser printers and his early interest in computers and video games. They recount how he transitioned from creating a zine called Cyber Surfer to meeting Jerry Colonna and Fred Wilson, which led to him reading business plans for what became Flatiron Group before he eventually started his own venture firm.
